name: Fear-extreme contrarian gated on bb_z washout (capitulation confluence, long)
rationale: MECHANISM: at extreme fear the marginal seller is a forced/panicked retail holder while patient capital (whales holding 10-10k BTC) accumulates and demands a discount for absorbing forced flow; the concession mean-reverts because the seller is liquidity-driven, not information-driven. The bb_z washout gate filters 'fear that is an overreaction' (snaps back) from 'fear that is correct — a real regime break' (does not). Entry: fear_greed below a fitted extreme-fear floor AND bb_z below a fitted deeply-negative floor (genuinely washed-out tape). Long spot into the discount. Exit: fear_greed crosses UP toward neutral (crowd un-panics) or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER: split entries by whether price was ALSO washed-out (bb_z<-1.5) vs not; if the confluence subset does not earn materially more than fear-alone, the TA gate adds nothing and this is just buy-the-dip beta — kill. Also kill if net-of-fee return does not beat buy-and-hold on the SAME oversold days (redundant with mean-reversion).
catalyst: extreme fear into a statistically washed-out tape
